name: Pro Football Archives (profootballarchives.com)
access: one request per second maximum, descriptive User-Agent with a contact address, cached on first fetch and never re-pulled. A small site run by one person since 2006.

RANK.position: a SECOND VOICE alongside StatsCrew, not above it
RANK.why: it is strongest exactly where the archive is thinnest -- high school 100% of pages in every band, transaction log 100%, death date 86-100% pre-1930 and 1930s-40s -- but it is a compilation, not a primary document, and it is one person's work.
RANK.disagreements: HELD, never resolved. Where PFA and StatsCrew differ, both values stay, both attributed.

IDENTITY.rule: resolve through the CLUB-SEASON ROSTER, never by guessing a player code. {year}.html gives club display names, {year}{league}{club}.html gives the roster, each name links to its player page.
IDENTITY.why: this confirms identity structurally -- the man is on PFA's own roster for that club in that year -- which satisfies the pre-1950 club rule by construction rather than by string matching.
IDENTITY._a_guessed_code_returned_the_wrong_man: players/q/quic00100.html is Brian Quick. Vernon Quick is quic00800.html. Codes are sequential within a surname prefix and cannot be derived.
IDENTITY.name_variants: declared contractions and prefixes only (Walt/Walter, Len/Leonard, Bob/Robert). A surname that differs by even one letter is NOT matched -- Audette is not Audet.

TRANSACTION_LOG._what: not a field on a person but a sequence of events: team, date, type. 2,053 entries across 264 men in the census, median 7 each.
TRANSACTION_LOG.ONLY_44_9_PERCENT_CARRY_A_DATE: the rest give team and type only.
TRANSACTION_LOG.shape: one claim per entry, predicate pfa.transaction, value {team, date, type, season_context}, plus dated (bool) and printed_row (int).
TRANSACTION_LOG.printed_row_IS_NOT_A_CHRONOLOGY: it records the row's position ON THE PAGE, which is what the source shows. It must never be read as a date, and an undated entry MUST NOT acquire one from its neighbours. A log that silently orders undated events asserts a sequence the source does not give.
TRANSACTION_LOG.raw_types_not_normalised: 44 distinct strings including Signed, Released, Free Agent, Draft, Allocation Draft, Expansion Draft, Signed by League. Allocation and Expansion Draft are different mechanisms from Draft, and Signed by League is not a club act at all. The mapping is a ruling and has not been made.

LEADS.ruling: men on a PFA roster who never played a game do NOT become people. The archive is built on who played.
LEADS.but: they are captured as LEADS with every field PFA carries, exactly as for a matched man, so a later promotion is a DECISION and not a re-fetch.
LEADS._evidence_for_the_ruling: PFA's 1948 Los Angeles Dons roster holds 64 men against the archive's 41. Gus Kitchens was signed 17 March 1948 and released 26 August 1948 -- in the press guide, never in a game.
LEADS.structure: the same lead shape built for the LA Dons guide: category, name as printed, source record, the club-season it places him on, why matching failed, candidate person, fields.

PHOTOGRAPHS: NONE. Measured at 0% across all 264 census pages -- the only image on a player page is the site logo. Do not look for them.
hard_rules: no claim attaches to an unmatched person
a lead carries the same field set as a matched man
a lead cannot become a person without an explicit ruling
an undated transaction cannot acquire a date
a disagreement with StatsCrew is held, never resolved
